challengeFindings.title: An at-limit holistic pause (loop question answered Decide, every gap Accept) routes continue, but the summary still lists build-plan-verify-holistic FAIL and the build ends FAIL
A fix round that edits source but reports Fixed: 0 pauses, the owner accepts the old gaps, and continue sends unverified edits on with no verify re-run
A run stopped between the build-decision row (route=continue) and the decision tick resumes at Plan Execute with the accepted tasks never ticked
An accepted gap titled `TASK 3` (copied from its TASK {N} gap line) ticks nothing, tasks tick --decision exits 0 and the route goes on to Step 7 unchecked
An all-Accept holistic pause on a gap that names an unticked task goes to Step 11 with no tick, where the old holistic re-run would have ticked it as satisfied
tasks tick --tasks=9 --decision=<file> on group 1 silently drops task 9 (group 2) and exits 0, where --tasks=9 alone exits 2

`tasks tick --decision` ticks tasks from any decision file, so a misrouted `Gate: FAIL` pause, a `From: holistic` file or another group's file marks tasks done while the group's tests are still red; the red-gate exclusion lives only in workflow prose

challengeFindings.title: An owner stops at an all-Accept verify or holistic pause and resumes later; the resumed Decision Pause has no SOURCE_CHANGED value, so step 6 either routes continue past fix-round edits no verify saw or re-runs the check the answers settled

A fix round edits source and reports Fixed: 0, the owner picks Stop at the holistic pause, and the resumed run answers Accept and routes continue, because `SOURCE_CHANGED` lives only in session memory and the resume rebuilds every other pause variable but not this one, so the unverified edits skip the verify re-run

An accepted verify gap with no task number, titled with its verifier-written description such as `No test covers the retry path that task 2 adds`, ticks task 2 as done, because the case-insensitive, unanchored title match added by the Task 9 fix finds a task number anywhere in the title, so an unfinished task passes the summary's unticked-task gate
